selection: The port test exercises issue backpressure, the two flush inputs, writeback by transaction ID, in-order commit and scoreboard capacity using the fixed scoreboard and operand reader. The reconstructed CV-X-IF developer test executes all ten operations through the complete CPU and checks architectural register updates.
